pages.title: Breathing Underwater
pages.text: Ice dragons can breathe underwater as easily as on land. In human form they explore underwater and, while guarding, follow their owner beneath the surface.$(br2)Fire and lightning dragons must surface to breathe. Leave them a way up when crossing water.
Light follows us beneath the river.

pages.title: Underwater Movement
pages.text: When wandering or guarding, an ice dragon finds its own way through water. It also follows an owner who dives while guarding, with no separate dive command.$(br2)At the surface it floats calmly; underwater, its arms and tail help it swim.
